meta.name: Top Form
meta.description: Akin, a veteran actor and five-time "Sexiest Man of the Year," loses his title to rising star Jin, who secretly admires and loves him despite the rivalry.

videos.title: The Sexiest Man
videos.overview: Jin, a rookie actor, begins a new job on set alongside Akin a beloved star. Akin helps Jin make it through a challenging first day by helping him conenct with the emotions of his character.

videos.title: Rising Star
videos.overview: Akin's fever lands him in the hospital, meanwhile, Jin joins a new agency that specializes in creating hype around their artists.

videos.title: The Legend of Gemini
videos.overview: Jin and Akin find another opportunity to film together. After some time apart, Jin has grown in his confidence and skills.

videos.title: Sweet Like Honey
videos.overview: After a night of drinks, Akin wakes up in Jin’s room. Jin starts giving him rides for 21 days, but on the final day, things take an unexpected turn.

videos.title: North Star
videos.overview: Jin and Akin's relationship grows stronger, but tension emerges when Jin takes over the title of the "Hottest Actor" award.

videos.title: The Johnny
videos.overview: While Akin rehearses his play and clashes with lead actor Johnny, a drunken night blurs boundaries. When Jin calls from abroad, it’s Johnny who answers.

videos.title: Bite Marks
videos.overview: Thinking he cheated, Akin tries to end it with Jin. But after the truth comes out, love deepens and Akin makes a life-changing proposal.

videos.title: Classroom Crush
videos.overview: Akin is being stalked by a malicious fan—a “sasaeng.”  Because of the sasaeng’s twisted actions, Akin is dragged into a serious crisis.

videos.title: Judy's Boy
videos.overview: Akin faces a new challenge as someone tries to blackmail him, causing him to push Jin further away.

videos.title: Flower and Tear
videos.overview: Just after resolving the leaked photo incident, sorrow knocks at their door—Akın’s grandmother has passed. Stricken with grief, he returns home with Jin, ready to say a final goodbye.

videos.title: Mi Tesoro
videos.overview: To honor his grandmother’s final work, Akin strikes a deal with Jin—and the road to the Best Actor Award begins.
